# third_party/rggen-sv-rtl

Runtime SystemVerilog that the committed RgGen-generated CSR needs in order to be
compiled. It is vendored so that the public Verilator demo does not require an
RgGen installation: generation still uses RgGen, simulation uses the committed
generated CSR (`rtl/generated/rggen/ldo_csr.sv`) plus these files.

## Provenance

| item | value |
|---|---|
| upstream | `https://github.com/rggen/rggen-sv-rtl` (RgGen SystemVerilog frontend, common RTL) |
| commit | `6b3f25a08fdbe87c6ab0bccbf83d9a16eb6974f7` (2026-02-05) |
| license | MIT, Copyright (c) 2019-2026 Taichi Ishitani -- see `LICENSE` in this directory |
| used by | `sim/apb_system_tb.sv` via `sim/run_verilator.sh` |
| compiled artifact | `rtl/generated/rggen/ldo_csr.sv` (generated by rggen-systemverilog 0.36.0) |

These files are **unmodified copies** of the upstream files at that commit; the
upstream files carry no per-file license header, so the upstream `LICENSE` is
kept alongside them. Nothing in this directory is generated by, or maintained by,
this repository.

## Which files, and why exactly these

Upstream publishes its supported compile sets as `compile_core.rb` +
`compile_apb.rb` (19 files for an APB adapter). That set was reduced to the files
this CSR configuration actually needs by removing one file at a time and
re-running the full Verilator build of `sim/apb_system_tb.sv`. The optional
`RGGEN_ENABLE_BACKDOOR` / `RGGEN_ENABLE_SVA` variants are not used.

Included (13):

```text
rggen_rtl_pkg.sv            rggen_adapter_common.sv
rggen_or_reducer.sv         rggen_apb_if.sv
rggen_mux.sv                rggen_apb_adapter.sv
rggen_bit_field_if.sv       rggen_address_decoder.sv
rggen_bit_field.sv          rggen_register_common.sv
rggen_register_if.sv        rggen_default_register.sv
rggen_bus_if.sv
```

Deliberately not included (unused by a two-register CSR whose PGOOD field is
`ro`/live and whose EN field is a plain RW bit): `rggen_bit_field_counter.sv`,
`rggen_bit_field_w01trg.sv`, `rggen_external_register.sv`,
`rggen_indirect_register.sv`, `rggen_maskable_register.sv`,
`rggen_apb_bridge.sv`, and the bus protocol files for AXI4-Lite / Avalon /
Wishbone / native.

`rggen_rtl_pkg.sv` must precede the files that use its typedefs when the list is
passed to Verilator.

## Updating

If the CSR configuration changes (a new field type, a counter, another bus
protocol), re-derive the required set: start from upstream's `compile_core.rb`
plus the relevant `compile_<protocol>.rb`, copy the missing files verbatim, and
confirm that `./sim/run_verilator.sh` still passes. Do not edit these files here.
